display.title: I Thank You, Hashem (Song)
display.summary_short: A short song of thanks to Hashem.
display.summary_long: A short recording, about a minute and a half long, of the song "I Thank You, Hashem." Only the opening words are transcribed; the rest of the recording is presumably singing or music, which the transcription does not capture. The song expresses gratitude to Hashem, a theme that runs through the storytelling recordings in this collection, and it may have been used as an opening or closing song for the weekly stories. Listen to the audio for the full words and melody.

quality.notes: Only 'I thank you, Hashem' transcribed (0:00-0:02); the remaining ~93 s are presumably the song. Not trimmed; check by ear. 'Wachsman' in the filename may be the singer or composer.
